question: Which of the following texts, related to the history of the Delhi Sultanate, was authored by Ziauddin Barani?
solution:
The answer is __**Tarikh-i-Firozshahi**____.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ziauddin Barani** was a** political thinker of the Delhi Sultanate during Tughlaq Dynasty.**
 
• He was renowned for his work **Tarikh-i-Firozshahi** which was the** finest specimen on Indo-Persian histography produced during Sultanate Period**.
 
• It is considered part of** Tarikh Twarikh.**
 
• Ziauddin Barani also wrote a book on the classical work of Statescraft named **Fatawa-i-Jahandari.**
 
• Ziauddin Barani was also famous for his **political criticism and boldness.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information __**

 
• **​Muntakhab-al-tawarikh** to tarik-i-badauni is a famous book describing the early Mughal history written by **Abd-al-Qadr.**
 
• **Mirat-i-Ahmadi** is a political and statistical history of Gujarat composed and written by **Ali Mohammad Khan.**
 
• **Taj-ul-Masir** is the first official history of Delhi sultanate written in Persian by **Sadrudin Hasan Nizami.**
